verified_facts.text: The hotel is set on Rome's highest hilltop, with panoramic views of the city and St. Peter's Dome.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on Rome’s highest hilltop and boasting panoramic views of the Eternal City and St. Peter’s Dome

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in 15 acres of Mediterranean parkland.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Rome Cavalieri hotel is nestled in 15 acres of lush Mediterranean park

verified_facts.text: The hotel's park sits at the top of Monte Mario, with Aleppo pines, palms and pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the top of Monte Mario, high above Rome, there is a verdant green park, where Aleppo pines, palms and pools refresh.

verified_facts.text: La Pergola is the hotel's rooftop restaurant from chef Heinz Beck.
verified_facts.excerpt: Michelin-starred La Pergola, our rooftop restaurant from renowned chef Heinz Beck

verified_facts.text: La Pergola's wine list draws on a cellar of over 70,000 bottles.
verified_facts.excerpt: a wine list that comes from a cellar with over 70,000 world-class bottles

verified_facts.text: La Pergola offers a water list with 45 choices.
verified_facts.excerpt: a water list featuring 45 choices

verified_facts.text: Uliveto, beside the outdoor pool, serves Mediterranean and international dishes and a Sunday brunch.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adjacent to the outdoor pool, Uliveto offers Mediterranean and international dishes with regional specialties from across Italy. Start your day with a delicious breakfast and enjoy a vast range of delicacies at Sunday brunch.

verified_facts.text: Tiepolo Lounge & Terrace serves cocktails and aperitivo, sometimes with live jazz.
verified_facts.excerpt: especially when there is live jazz to soothe you into the evening. Enjoy pastries and light bites by day followed by an exciting array of innovative cocktails and aperitivo.

verified_facts.text: A grand high tea is served in Tiepolo Lounge and Terrace during the winter months.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us throughout the winter months for a grand high tea in Tiepolo Lounge and Terrace

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has a sliding glass ceiling opening onto a private rooftop garden with a hot tub facing St. Peter's Dome.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sliding glass ceiling opens onto a private rooftop garden, where you can admire views of St. Peter's Dome from the hot tub.

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse Suite features works by Andy Warhol and furniture designed by Karl Lagerfeld.
verified_facts.excerpt: this suite features works by Andy Warhol and furniture designed by Karl Lagerfeld

verified_facts.text: The Planetarium Suite has a twinkling LED ceiling above the bed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stargaze from the comfort of your bed, beneath the Planetarium Suite's twinkling LED ceiling.

verified_facts.text: The Napoleon Suite includes a writing desk once owned by Napoleon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rare empire furniture, including a writing desk once owned by Napoleon, features in this elegant suite.

verified_facts.text: The Petronius Suite, the hotel's largest accommodation, has four large balconies and a private wine cellar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Four large balconies, a private wine cellar, old masters and rare 18th-century furnishings highlight our largest accommodation.

verified_facts.text: The Imperial Club on the seventh floor is for guests in Imperial Rooms or Suites, with complimentary snacks and drinks through the day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Available to guests who have reserved Imperial Rooms or Suites, the Imperial Club is located on the seventh floor.

verified_facts.text: The Cavalieri Grand Spa Club centers on an amethyst Turkish bath framed by marble platforms and Roman mosaics.
verified_facts.excerpt: the magnificent amethyst Turkish bath, framed by marble platforms and Roman mosaics at the centre of the Club

verified_facts.text: The spa's Relaxation Lounge is a re-creation of a Roman rotunda.
verified_facts.excerpt: retire to the Relaxation Lounge, a re-creation of a Roman rotunda

verified_facts.text: The spa uses La Prairie and Natura Bisse treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treat your skin to La Prairie’s exclusive Swiss treatments and Natura Bissé’s sustainable skincare

verified_facts.text: Beyond the main pool, the park has two family-friendly pools, one exclusively for small children, plus an indoor pool under a glass dome.
verified_facts.excerpt: Deeper into the park, discover two family-friendly pools – one exclusively for small children. Beneath a beautiful glass dome, our indoor pool and whirlpool are perfect for a winter dip.

verified_facts.text: Two floodlit clay tennis courts meet Davis Cup standard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two clay tennis courts meet Davis Cup standard and are floodlit for evening games.

verified_facts.text: An 800-metre fitness trail runs through the hotel's gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Walk, jog, or run along the 800-metre fitness trail through the hotel’s exquisite gardens.

verified_facts.text: In summer, the IT Club kids club is complimentary for hotel guests aged 4 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Available in summer, the IT Club – League of Young Cavaliers is complimentary to all hotel guests aged 4-12.

verified_facts.text: Guests over seven can train as gladiators in the hotel's park with instructors from Rome's Gladiatorial School.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the hotel’s private park, overlooking the Roman skyline, instructors from Rome’s Gladiatorial School teach ancient combat techniques

verified_facts.text: The hotel houses more than a thousand artworks dating from the fourteenth century to today, toured with a resident art historian.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tour the private art collection with our resident art historian. This hotel houses more than a thousand artistic treasures dating from the fourteenth century to today.

verified_facts.text: The Rome Cavalieri first opened in 1963.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Rome Cavalieri first opened its doors in 1963

verified_facts.text: The hotel joined the Waldorf Astoria collection in 2008.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 2008, it joined the Waldorf Astoria collection

verified_facts.text: The art collection includes Giambattista Tiepolo paintings, signed Warhols and a 1725 Beauvais tapestry.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel’s extensive art collection, which includes Giambattista Tiepolo paintings, original signed Warhols, and a rare Beauvais Tapestry from 1725

verified_facts.text: The hotel runs a free hourly shuttle bus to and from Via Veneto.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel runs a free hourly shuttle bus, which drops off and picks up on Via Veneto

verified_facts.text: The hotel is about a 15-minute drive into the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rome Cavalieri is a 15-minute drive into the city

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome, with a pet-sitting service and a pet spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets are welcome at the Rome Cavalieri; there’s even a pet-sitting service and a pet spa for pooches.

verified_facts.text: In summer, Patio 101 is a garden eatery with a wood-fired oven.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the summertime you can head straight from the pool to dinner at Patio 101, a laid-back garden eatery where the open kitchen has a huge wood-fired oven

unresolved.text: La Pergola is Rome's first and only three-Michelin-star restaurant.
